visual_findings: Scanner RGB order appears plausible in all seven. The two automated passes include a blood-rich kidney field (TCGA-G7-A8LD-01Z-00-DX1_1) with sparse nuclei, and a prostate field (TCGA-G9-6356-01Z-00-DX1_3) with partial virtual-DAPI/StarDist correspondence. Both still have diffuse CK/CD68 patterns and no marker-specific ground truth; hold them from protein-validity claims. The five failures show blur, weak nuclear contrast, broad shading or mismatched DAPI. In particular, the two dense kidney TCGA-P4-AAVK fields have high global AUC but contrast below the QC threshold and visible diffuse DAPI; do not override their failures.
scope: Preview-scale inspection of cases 58-64 from an active 93-case CPU bundle. No protein-specific reference exists for these MoNuSAC fields.
